english.title: Fishing vessel owner / skipper / employer employed / engaged to work on board a fishing vessel person under 18
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[were the owner of a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), on board which a person under 18 years of age was employed or engaged to work, the nature of the activities, or the circumstances in which they were carried out, being]_
(B)_[were the skipper of a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), on board which a person under 18 years of age was employed or engaged to work, the nature of the activities, or the circumstances in which they were carried out, being]_
(C)_[employed a person under 18 years of age to work on board a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), where the nature of the activities, or the circumstances in which they were carried out, were]_

likely to jeopardize that person's health, safety or morals
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 6(3) and (4) and 29(1) of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018.
